summary: Backend testing for PARTNER Single Device Login feature. Wrote and executed pytest suite (7 tests) covering: first device binding, same-device relogin, different-device 403 with detail.code='device_mismatch', admin reset-device, new-device binding after reset with OLD token revoked (401 detail.code='device_revoked'), customer NOT device-locked (multiple tokens work), and backward compatibility (no device_id when no binding). All 7 tests PASSED. Post-run cleanup executed: admin reset-device for partner uid 42e57f91-... confirmed partner can log in without device_id and /auth/me returns 200.
critical_code_review_comments: Structured error detail (dict with code+message) is implemented correctly for both 403 device_mismatch and 401 device_revoked responses.
Partner-only device lock scope is enforced (customer logins from multiple devices are unaffected).
Backward compatibility works: absence of device_id is permitted when partner has no existing binding.
seed_data_creation: None. Only transient device bindings which were cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Single-device login tests reside at /app/backend/tests/test_single_device_login.py and include auto-cleanup fixture that resets the partner device binding before and after run. Safe to reuse. Behavior verified: verify-otp accepts optional device_id; partners get bound; admin POST /api/admin/people/partner/{uid}/reset-device clears binding; /auth/me returns 401 detail.code='device_revoked' for stale partner tokens; non-partner roles unaffected.
